name: Indexsy
description: Operator-led SEO, content, and link-building services sold as packaged products — AuditStack $50, local guest posts from $90, niche edits from $95, "LLM Booster" from $99, local PBN citations from $250, BrowserBlast from $250 (company-stated). Founded Dec 2015, CA. Founder Jacky Chou. Domain indexsy.com, DR 65.

mentions.evidence: ~$44,506 MRR (−17.6% L30), 28 active subscriptions, ~$87,749 L30 (−19.4%; snapshot ~$88,204), ~$304,144 last 3 months, ~$613,728 last 6 months, ~$989,445 last 12 months, ~$2,689,990 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 10, 2026 ~04:02 Warsaw (02:02 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Productize one SEO SKU for PL/EU SaaS — "ChatGPT / AI Overview citation pack" (the Indexsy "LLM Booster" wedge) sold as a €499 audit + €1.5k/mo content retainer. Don't rebuild a full agency; sell one measurable outcome.

whyItPrints: SEO services with a productized price list is the original boring internet business. 28 subscriptions at ~$44.5k MRR implies ~$1.6k/mo average retainer (my calculation) — high-ticket, not self-serve freemium. L30 cash (~$88k) > MRR because a chunk is one-time audits / link orders. Eleven years in; ~$2.7M all-time.
